Resident employees: CT wages = all wages regardless of where services performed; where employer must withhold for another state, CT tax is prorated and only the excess remitted (Example 4). Nonresidents: CT wages = wages for services performed in CT, allocated on CT-W4NA; 15-day rule: no withholding if 15 days or less in CT in the calendar year, but if more than 15 days, withhold on all CT-service pay including the first 15 days (PS 2015(6)). No reciprocity agreement appears anywhere in IP 2026(1) (full-text search 'reciproc': none).
